summary: Webhook health down: no event for 2846 min while a PR changed in the last 120 min

options.description: Operator restarts the forwarder or re-registers the hook
Stay poll-only and accept the gh call rate

body: Webhook health is down: no event for 2846 min while a PR changed in the last 120 min. Signals: {"receiver":true,"port":true,"lastEventAgeMin":2846,"prActivityWithoutEvent":true,"prActivity":true,"quiet":false,"forwarder":"unknown","feed":"none"}. Dispatch keeps working by polling gh (about 2,700 calls an hour), which is the rate-limit pressure. Fix (operator only; it touches your GitHub account and network): restart the feed with `gh webhook forward --repo <owner>/<repo> --events pull_request,check_suite,check_run,workflow_run,status,pull_request_review --url http://127.0.0.1:8765/webhooks/github` and record it with `cli-hierarchy webhook up --feed gh-forward`, or re-register the repository hook (secret equal to AI_SDLC_WEBHOOK_SECRET). If the receiver itself is down run `cli-hierarchy webhook up`. Episode since 2026-11-05T21:32:31.178Z.
